args.query: generate JSON Schema from existing TypeScript interfaces at build time, not from zod schemas

results.title: Generate TypeScript types from JSON Schema with json-schema-to-typescript
results.summary: Compile JSON Schemas into TypeScript interfaces with json-schema-to-typescript, covering required and optional fields, enums, $ref definitions, descriptions as JSDoc and strict additionalProperties.

results.title: Zod v4 schemas exported to JSON Schema and checked with Ajv
results.summary: Export Zod v4 schemas to JSON Schema 2020-12 with z.toJSONSchema, using .meta() ids and descriptions and input vs output modes, then validate the same data with Ajv 2020.

results.title: Zod 4 schemas to an OpenAPI 3.1 document with zod-to-openapi
results.summary: Register Zod 4 schemas, path and query parameters, security schemes and routes in an OpenAPIRegistry and generate an OpenAPI 3.1 document (JSON and YAML) from the same schemas used for runtime validation, tested offline.

results.title: Drizzle ORM + drizzle-zod validated inserts on SQLite
results.summary: Generate Zod insert and select schemas from Drizzle tables with drizzle-zod, refine them, and validate input before inserting into SQLite.

results.title: Fastify 5 + Zod 4 type provider for typed routes
results.summary: Use fastify-type-provider-zod so Zod 4 schemas validate requests, serialize responses and type handlers in Fastify 5.

results.title: LangChain.js tools with Zod schemas and a manual tool-calling loop
results.summary: Define LangChain.js tools with tool() and Zod schemas, run model tool_calls through them, and feed ToolMessages back, tested with a scripted fake chat model.

results.title: React Hook Form + Zod 4 resolver schemas (no DOM)
results.summary: Share one Zod schema between React Hook Form (via @hookform/resolvers) and the server, with cross-field refinements, tested by calling the resolver directly.

results.title: NestJS Zod ValidationPipe for body DTOs
results.summary: Validate NestJS request bodies with a reusable Zod ValidationPipe that returns 400 field errors, tested through @nestjs/testing and supertest without relying on emitDecoratorMetadata.

results.title: Ajv standalone validation code generated at build time
results.summary: Compile JSON Schemas once with Ajv into standalone ESM validator modules, write them to disk and import them at runtime without compiling, checking errors, defaults and type coercion.

results.title: Hono + @hono/zod-openapi typed routes with generated OpenAPI docs
results.summary: Define Hono routes with createRoute and Zod schemas so requests are validated, handlers are typed and an OpenAPI 3.1 document is generated at /doc.
